//: Composite indexes Firestore cannot infer. Deployed by the Deploy Firestore
The emulator does NOT enforce these — it answers any query happily — so a
missing index only shows up in production, as a failed export on a client's
screen. That is exactly why they are declared here rather than created by
hand from a console link when something breaks.

indexes.//: zatcaChain: this tenant's chain head and recent invoices.

//: zatcaExport: a date range for one tenant, paged. invoice_number is in
the sort so the cursor is unambiguous — ordering on timestamp alone
would skip invoices sharing a second, which a busy till produces.

indexes.//: loadArchivedRange: a client's own bills across a date range.
